source_audit: Terence Tao, Product set estimates for non-commutative groups, arXiv:math/0601431v3, https://arxiv.org/pdf/math/0601431v3, Lemma3.6, Definition3.8 and Theorem3.10 (read R1798). R1799 proves the continuous finite-packing cover, constructs U=T^3 using the R1798 n=7 bound, and retains an actual symmetric Y subset U^2. It reuses Mathlib.Combinatorics.Additive.ApproximateSubgroup.IsApproximateSubgroup rather than introducing a duplicate predicate. That library predicate does not require symmetry/containment of its finite witness, so these stronger source conditions are separately proved and returned. The existing finite-set small-tripling theorem does not apply to our continuous positive-Haar-volume sets; the continuous covering proof is supplied. These are supporting formalizations of known arguments, not new impossibility theorems.
